description: VR mod for FEZ (Steam): the game as a 3D diorama in a SteamVR headset, with motion controllers.
notes: FEZ-VR is installed next to FEZ.exe in your FEZ folder (found through Steam). FEZ's own files are not changed.
The first install adds 'FEZ VR' to your Steam and SteamVR libraries with FEZ's artwork, plus desktop / Start menu shortcuts (Steam closes and restarts once).
Play 'FEZ VR' from Steam, SteamVR or the shortcut. Regular FEZ stays flat.
Game in an unusual place? Set the FEZVR_GAMEDIR environment variable to its folder and install again.

script: # Updates only refresh the mod and its launcher; Steam is restarted only when the FEZ VR entry is first added.
# On update the new version installs over the old one; only a real uninstall removes the mod.
